task.description: Implement ISS-107 per the design at templates/specs/GBL-tenant-storage-mode.migration.yaml. (1) Run the codegen: python tools/codegen_migration.py templates/specs/GBL-tenant-storage-mode.migration.yaml — this generates migrations/084_iss107_tenant_storage_mode.sql and a test scaffold. IMPORTANT: Verify 084 is the next free number. If taken by the concurrent ISS-104 branch, use the next free. (2) Edit src/db/provisioning.zig: in the provisionTenantSchema() function (or equivalent), after the step that updates migrations_applied_at, add step 6a: UPDATE tenant SET storage_mode = 'SCHEMA' WHERE id = $1::uuid — this ensures newly provisioned tenants default to SCHEMA. The migration's DEFAULT 'LEGACY_RLS' handles existing tenants. NOTE: the actual table name is 'tenant' (singular), not 'tenants' as the requirement doc says. Use the real table name everywhere. (3) Validate: zig build (exit 0, no 'error set' output), zig build test (exit 0), zig build migrate (exit 0, idempotent on re-run). (4) Commit and push to feature branch.
